show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: From delivering food to delivering justice, Vikram becomes the Chief Minister for just seven days to take down a corrupt political empire. Using his secret tech team, he exposes massive scams, but now the powerful elite have ordered a deadly hit on him. As assassins storm his house, Vikram starts one last live stream to reveal the ultimate evidence to the world. With the clock ticking, will he finish the broadcast before the screen goes black?
